verdict.rationale: Stripe supports usage-based billing via Meter events and provides webhooks for real-time event data, plus a customer portal and analytics dashboard for account management, but there is no documented feature for configuring usage thresholds or proactive alerts to warn customers/teams before an invoice is generated. missing for 10: explicit usage-threshold/alert configuration, a real-time customer-facing usage-cost dashboard, and any evidence of proactive notifications preventing invoice surprises.
